candidates.name: whoami
verified_facts: whoami reports the current logged-on domain and user identity
whoami can report the current access token's groups, privileges, SID, claims and logon identifier
semantic_limits: Token identity and listed privileges do not prove that a specific file write, Git authentication, runner lock acquisition or receipt publication succeeded

candidates.name: Get-LocalUser
verified_facts: Get-LocalUser retrieves built-in, created and Microsoft-connected local user accounts
The LocalAccounts module is unavailable in 32-bit PowerShell on a 64-bit system
semantic_limits: A local-account record does not establish the identity of the running recovery process or effective access to canonical repository paths

candidates.name: Get-LocalGroupMember
verified_facts: Get-LocalGroupMember retrieves members from a specified local security group
Members can be identified by name or security identifier
semantic_limits: Membership in a local administrators group does not prove an elevated token, UAC consent, path write success or Git authorization

candidates.name: Get-Acl
verified_facts: Get-Acl retrieves a resource security descriptor such as a file or registry key
Default file-system output includes the owner and discretionary access-control entries
semantic_limits: ACL readback alone does not prove effective write access because token state, inheritance, denies, elevation and sharing conditions can still affect access

candidates.name: Get-AuthenticodeSignature
verified_facts: Get-AuthenticodeSignature retrieves Authenticode signature information for a file or byte content
Unsigned files still return signature information with blank signature fields
semantic_limits: A valid signature proves neither the canonical Git blob identity nor correct recovery behavior; the pinned blob SHA and script content must still match

candidates.name: Unblock-File
verified_facts: Unblock-File removes the internet-origin blocking state used by Windows for downloaded files
Running Unblock-File on an unblocked file has no effect
semantic_limits: Unblocking changes file security metadata and must not be performed automatically merely to make recovery pass; detection and operator approval remain separate

candidates.name: Set-StrictMode
verified_facts: Set-StrictMode enforces coding rules in the current scope and child scopes
Strict mode can turn uninitialized variables, missing properties and invalid indexes into errors
semantic_limits: Strict mode does not validate business logic, external command success, receipt authenticity or Git publication

candidates.name: about_Preference_Variables
verified_facts: PowerShell preference variables customize command behavior within their scope
Setting ErrorActionPreference to Stop escalates non-terminating errors to stopping errors in the applicable scope
semantic_limits: ErrorActionPreference has nuanced interaction with native stderr and does not replace explicit native exit-code checks

candidates.name: about_Automatic_Variables
verified_facts: PowerShell maintains automatic variables including LASTEXITCODE, PID, PSCommandPath, PSScriptRoot and PSVersionTable
These variables expose native exit and script execution context that can be captured in a recovery receipt
semantic_limits: Automatic-variable values are session state and can be overwritten by later commands; they must be captured immediately and correlated with the exact command

candidates.name: Get-Content
verified_facts: Get-Content retrieves content from a specified item such as a file
Raw mode can return an entire file as one string for JSON parsing
semantic_limits: Reading content does not prove the file was produced by the canonical runner; identity, hash, freshness, ACL and schema checks remain required

candidates.name: Set-Content
verified_facts: Set-Content writes new content or replaces existing content in a file
The cmdlet supports explicit encoding selection for file-system content
semantic_limits: Set-Content is not documented as a crash-safe atomic replacement and must be confined to a staged path followed by validation and controlled move

candidates.name: Out-File
verified_facts: Out-File sends PowerShell output to a file using formatting semantics
Encoding and output width can affect the resulting file representation
semantic_limits: Formatted Out-File output must not be treated as canonical JSON serialization because formatting or width can alter or truncate representation

candidates.name: about_Character_Encoding
verified_facts: PowerShell cmdlets support multiple text encodings and defaults differ across editions and commands
Explicit encoding avoids ambiguity in cross-version receipt files
semantic_limits: Declaring an encoding does not prove a valid byte round trip; staged bytes must be read back and parsed

candidates.name: ConvertTo-Json
verified_facts: ConvertTo-Json converts .NET objects to JSON-formatted strings
PowerShell warns when object depth exceeds the requested serialization depth in supported versions
semantic_limits: Serialization success does not prove required fields were retained; depth, array shape and round-trip schema must be checked explicitly

candidates.name: Select-String
verified_facts: Select-String searches strings and files for text or regular-expression patterns
Literal paths, simple matching, case sensitivity and explicit encoding can make marker searches deterministic
semantic_limits: Finding expected text is diagnostic only and cannot replace JSON parsing, typed field validation or exact identity checks

candidates.name: Get-ItemProperty
verified_facts: Get-ItemProperty retrieves properties of specified items
It can read file properties and registry value data through PowerShell providers
semantic_limits: Property readback is supporting metadata and does not prove origin, authenticity, current process ownership or successful Git publication
